usedFor: Shopify is where the store runs and AnyDB is where you keep structured records. A “New Product” or “Order Cancelled” event in Shopify can add a row with “Create Record” in AnyDB, so launches and cancellations land in one database you can sort and link.

bestTemplate.name: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify, then “Create Record” in AnyDB
bestTemplate.why: An abandoned checkout carries the shopper's email or phone, so each one becomes a row you can follow up on. “Create Record” writes it into a database you choose, with cell values set.

watchOut: “Abandoned Checkout” is polling, so it is checked on a schedule and rows show up a little after the shopper leaves, not at that moment.
